title: 第21章 狂刀武馆第22章 劈柴练刀法
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
离开成衣店，赵寒打听了下东门的路线，便径直赶过去。
来到东门，又询问一番，得知卖野兽的铺面位于前面巷道内，便深入巷道。
“小子，不知道这是毒蛇帮的地盘吗，进来要给钱。”
赵寒刚踏步进去，一旁蹲守的三名毒蛇帮帮众，便一溜烟窜了出来，张嘴伸手要钱。
“毒蛇帮的地盘？钱？”
赵寒轻轻一笑，这是大水冲了龙王庙啊。
“这个够吗！”
赵寒随手施展了个蛇形刁手，展示的精妙无比。
“这，这……”三人顿时傻眼。
这人竟然是毒蛇帮的精锐帮众，否则蛇形刁手打不了这么好。
“大人，对不住对不住，是我们没眼力见，我自罚三巴掌。”
“啪啪啪！”
三人各自对着自己脸蛋抽了三巴掌，以示自罚惩戒。
“行了，我要买蟒蛇，这里面有卖的吗？”赵寒问道。
三人消息灵通，连忙解释：
“蟒蛇？没有没有，这里面都是卖小蛇的，蟒蛇一般有人卖的话，第一时间都会被帮主派人买走。”
赵寒问道：“帮主派人买走？难道帮主很急缺蟒蛇吗？”
“你难道不知道？据说帮主修炼的武功很厉害，一般的小蛇起不了作用，需要蟒蛇才行。”
帮众有些疑惑，这可是人人皆知的事，一个毒蛇帮的精锐帮众竟然不知道。
但他还是老老实实交代了。

“这样啊，那看来是没戏了。”赵寒转身便离开。
地头蛇都不知道，那这里自然是没蟒蛇了。
只能等哪天自己亲自去林中捕杀。
不过这得等到步入炼肉境再说，这就要靠黑狼拳了。
“大人慢走，我们仨不送了，下次再来！”
三人庆幸躲过一劫，这位精锐帮众脾气好，换做其他人，滋滋……
一句以下犯上，可有他们受的。
轻则拿钱走人，重则挨打断腿。
炼皮境的精锐帮众，和普通帮众，天生就是两个天差地别的群体，打死他们都不为过。
“先找个住的地方，顺带能练武的。”
差不多午时，赵寒吃了点空间里的食物，漫无目的走在大街上，四处打量着。
“猛虎镖局招趟子手和镖师，有两把刷子的可应聘趟子手，月钱五百文还有提成；炼皮武者，可为镖师，月钱二两银子提成更多！”
“许家雇佣护卫和护卫队长，护卫月钱四百文，护卫队长月钱伊犁一两五钱银子。”
“招收搬运苦力，早六晚八做三十天，包两餐和住房，一月三百文。”
……
街上不少招人的，和“武”扯上联系的，大都是“高薪”。
苦力、小二、杂工、短工等等，都是又苦又累，挣得还不多。
“狂刀武馆招收学徒，学费三两银子一月，没有硬性要求，自由练武，包吃包住，达到炼皮境可介绍高月钱的工作。”
“另招收杂工，杂工包吃包住，月钱一百文。”
“武馆！”
content_en:
After leaving the clothing store, Zhao Han inquired about the route to the east gate and rushed there.
When I came to the east gate, I asked again and learned that the shop selling wild animals was in the alley in front, so I went deep into the alley.
"Boy, don't you know this is the territory of the Viper Gang? You need to pay for coming in."
As soon as Zhao Han stepped in, the three Viper Gang members who were squatting on the side rushed out, opened their mouths and stretched out their hands to ask for money.
"The Vipers' territory? Money?"
Zhao Han smiled softly, it was a flood that washed away the Dragon King Temple.
"Is this enough?"
Zhao Han casually performed a snake-shaped trick, which was extremely subtle.
"This, this..." The three of them were dumbfounded.
This person turned out to be an elite member of the Viper Gang, otherwise the snake-shaped villain wouldn't be able to fight so well.
"Sir, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, it's because we didn't have the eyesight to see. I'll slap myself three times."
"Bah bang bang!"
The three of them slapped themselves three times on the face each as a sign of self-punishment.
"Okay, I want to buy a python. Are there any for sale here?" Zhao Han asked.
The three people were well-informed and quickly explained:
"Boa constrictor? No, no, there are people selling small snakes here. Generally, if someone sells a python, the gang leader will send someone to buy it immediately."
Zhao Han asked: "The gang leader sent someone to buy them? Is the gang leader in urgent need of pythons?"
"Don't you know? It is said that the martial arts practiced by the gang leader are very powerful. Ordinary small snakes cannot do it. A python is needed."
The gang members were a little confused. This was something everyone knew, but an elite member of the Viper Gang didn't know it.
But he still confessed honestly.
"That's it, it seems like there's no chance." Zhao Han turned around and left.
Even the local snakes don’t know about it, so naturally there are no pythons here.
I can only wait for the day when I go to the forest to hunt in person.
But this will have to wait until you enter the meat refining realm, which will depend on the Black Wolf Fist.
"Sir, go slowly. The three of us won't see you off anymore. Come back next time!"
The three of them were lucky to escape the disaster. This elite gang member had a good temper, but if it were anyone else, Zizi...
If you commit more than one sentence, they will be punished.
It ranges from taking the money and leaving, to having his legs broken at worst.
The elite gang members in the Skin Refining Realm and the ordinary gang members are two completely different groups by nature, and it would not be an exaggeration to kill them.
"Find a place to live first, and someone who can practice martial arts."
At almost noon, Zhao Han ate some food in the space and walked aimlessly on the street, looking around.
"The Tiger Escort Bureau is looking for escorts and bodyguards. Those with two brushes can apply for the job as a bodyguard, and the monthly salary is 500 silver and there will be a commission; skin-refining warriors can be employed as bodyguards, and the monthly salary is 2 taels of silver, and the commission will be more!"
"The Xu family hires guards and guard captains. The guards are paid four hundred cents per month, and the guard captain Yili is paid one or two and five cents per month."
"Recruiting moving coolies, working from 6 a.m. to 8 a.m. for 30 days, including two meals and housing, 300 cash a month."
…
There are many people recruiting people on the street, and those who are related to "Martial Arts" are mostly "high-paying" people.
Coolies, waiters, handymen, part-time workers, etc. are all hard and tiring and don't earn much.
"The Crazy Sword Martial Arts Hall is recruiting apprentices. The tuition is three taels of silver per month. There are no hard requirements. You can practice martial arts freely, and food and accommodation are included. If you reach the Skin Refining Stage, you can be introduced to jobs with high monthly wages."
"Recruiting another handyman. The handyman will provide food and accommodation. The monthly salary is one hundred cash."
"Martial arts gym!"
